Subject: Notes + artifacts: CAIQ walkthrough & log retention matrix (recap)

Alex — great to meet yesterday. Short recap and action items below.

Meeting notes (high level):
- Walked through the CAIQ answers you flagged. We clarified our identity/auth flows:
  - End-user auth is customer-managed (OIDC) when integrated via SSO; Redwood issues short-lived service tokens for model serving; rotation cadence: tokens rotated every 30 days, keys rotated quarterly.
  - We annotated three CAIQ cells (Auth-2, Crypt-5, Ops-3) with notes — see updated sheet.
- Logs: types and retention
  - Access logs (authentication, API calls): default retention 90 days, can be extended to 12 months on Dedicated/Private plans
  - Application request logs (model inputs/outputs): default 30 days; redaction applied to model inputs when requested by customer policy
  - Audit trails (admin actions, config changes): retained for 12 months by default
- Artifact delivery
  - We uploaded: sample-redacted-access.csv, retention-matrix.pdf, redaction-playbook-excerpt.pdf to the Drive folder. Link below.
  - If you need raw logs we’ll start an artifact request and share via secure transfer after the signed artifact addendum (NDA extension).

Action items (owners / ETA):
- Dylan: upload sample-redacted-access.csv and retention-matrix.pdf to Drive (done) — link below (by EOD 2027-04-03)
- Hannah: update the CAIQ cells and re-upload final CAIQ with clarifying notes (done) — see attached updated CAIQ
- Marissa: share standard artifact addendum template and HubSpot NB-3247 compliance notes (by 2027-04-05)
- Alex / Nimbus: confirm whether you want retention extended on access logs for the HIPAA-adjacent BU (reply to thread)

Attachments provided (stubs):

- retention-matrix.pdf (retention by data type)

- redaction-playbook-excerpt.pdf
